selection.label: Select the CyberAlchemy ontology-product node and relation slice
selection.rationale: The selected ontology-product slice is the closest semantic match to the event-sourced ontology engine and exercises role, claim, evidence confidence, commitment confidence, open-question, source-reference, forbidden-collapse, and relation-vocabulary shapes at a bounded 23-node and 24-relation scale.

resolved: No owner-selected legacy ontology slice existed for SWU-W7-001.
established: Only the three exact selected_legacy_slice files may be read as W7 migration inputs.
The selected slice may be mapped and replayed once in an isolated empty event store under the W6ACC-1 allowlist.
not_established: Admission, acceptance, normalization, or mutation of the source ontology
Selection of any unlisted file or ontology package
W8 PASS, migration cutover, publication, release, deployment, credentials, destructive action, or external effects

remaining_blockers.statement: The selected slice has not yet been mapped, replayed, and validated in isolation.

claim_ceiling: This decision selects only three exact read-only legacy source files for the already authorized isolated W7 rehearsal. It does not admit, accept, normalize in place, mutate, publish, release, deploy, or cut over any ontology and grants no credential, destructive-action, or external-effect authority.
